'''Ren Chandin''' was a resident of the [[Two Rivers]]. 

== Activities ==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] sets up an ambush for a group of [[Trolloc]]s in the Two Rivers, they were betrayed by [[Slayer|Lord Luc]] and Ren was killed when the Trollocs ambushed Perrin's group.{{ref/book|4|40}}
